title: Nothing
script:
-- Global Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Clean previous GUI
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("AlphaGodGUI") then
    CoreGui.AlphaGodGUI:Destroy()
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- UI SCALING & FLOATING ORB ENGINE
---------------------------------------------------------
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AlphaGodGUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

-- 1. FLOATING ANIMATED ORB (TOGGLE BUTTON)
local FloatingOrb = Instance.new("TextButton")
FloatingOrb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
FloatingOrb.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.45, 0)
FloatingOrb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
FloatingOrb.Text = "🌸"
FloatingOrb.TextSize = 28
FloatingOrb.Active = true
FloatingOrb.Draggable = true
FloatingOrb.Parent = ScreenGui

local OrbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
OrbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
OrbCorner.Parent = FloatingOrb

local OrbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
OrbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 80)
OrbStroke.Thickness = 2.5
OrbStroke.Parent = FloatingOrb

-- Rotating Effect for Orb
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.03) do
        FloatingOrb.Rotation = (FloatingOrb.Rotation + 2) % 360
    end
end)

-- 2. MODERN GLASSMORPHISM MAIN PANEL
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 320)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.25, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 18)
MainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
MainFrame.Visible = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local FrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FrameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
FrameCorner.Parent = MainFrame

local FrameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
FrameStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 90)
FrameStroke.Thickness = 2
FrameStroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- Header
local Header = Instance.new("Frame")
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
Header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
Header.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
Header.Parent = MainFrame

local HeaderText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
HeaderText.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
HeaderText.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 0)
HeaderText.Text = "APX TITAN ENGINE V10"
HeaderText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HeaderText.TextSize = 18
HeaderText.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
HeaderText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
HeaderText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HeaderText.Parent = Header

-- Minimize Button
local MinimizeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 35)
MinimizeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.1, 0)
MinimizeBtn.Text = "-"
MinimizeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinimizeBtn.TextSize = 24
MinimizeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
MinimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 60)
MinimizeBtn.Parent = Header

local MinCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MinCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
MinCorner.Parent = MinimizeBtn

-- Toggle Logic with Smooth Scaling Animation
local isMinimized = false
local function ToggleGUI()
    if isMinimized then
        MainFrame.Visible = true
        MainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 320), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, 0.3, true)
        isMinimized = false
    else
        MainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true, function()
            MainFrame.Visible = false
        end)
        isMinimized = true
    end
end

FloatingOrb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleGUI)
MinimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleGUI)

---------------------------------------------------------
-- TITAN GROWTH ENGINE (EXTREME SCALE OVERRIDE)
---------------------------------------------------------
local Container = Instance.new("Frame")
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
Container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Container.Parent = MainFrame

local StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
StatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
StatusLabel.Text = "STATUS: NORMAL SIZE"
StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
StatusLabel.TextSize = 16
StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusLabel.Parent = Container

local GiantBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
GiantBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
GiantBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
GiantBtn.Text = "💥 BECOME BUILDING-SIZED TITAN 💥"
GiantBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
GiantBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 20, 60)
GiantBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
GiantBtn.TextSize = 16
GiantBtn.Parent = Container

local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
BtnCorner.Parent = GiantBtn

local isGiant = false

GiantBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if humanoid then
            isGiant = not isGiant
            
            if isGiant then
                -- Scale Variables for Extreme Height
                local BodyScales = {"BodyHeightScale", "BodyWidthScale", "BodyDepthScale", "HeadScale"}
                for _, scaleName in ipairs(BodyScales) do
                    local scaleVal = humanoid:FindFirstChild(scaleName)
                    if scaleVal then
                        scaleVal.Value = 25 -- Massive Giant Size Factor
                    end
                end
                
                -- Mesh Part Extraterrestrial Size Override (Local Character Scaling)
                for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.Size = part.Size * 5
                    end
                end

                StatusLabel.Text = "STATUS: TITAN OVERLORD ACTIVE"
                StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
                GiantBtn.Text = "🔄 RESET NORMAL SIZE"
            else
                humanoid:BuildRigFromAttachments() -- Reset Scale
                StatusLabel.Text = "STATUS: NORMAL SIZE"
                StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
                GiantBtn.Text = "💥 BECOME BUILDING-SIZED TITAN 💥"
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- Additional Chat Blast Button inside GUI
local BlastBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
BlastBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
BlastBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 115)
BlastBtn.Text = "⚡ SERVER DOMINATION ANNOUNCEMENT"
BlastBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BlastBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 200)
BlastBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
BlastBtn.TextSize = 14
BlastBtn.Parent = Container

local BlastCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BlastCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
BlastCorner.Parent = BlastBtn

BlastBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local msg = "🌌 APX TITAN HAS RISEN TO DESTROY THE CITY 🌌"
    local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if generalChannel then generalChannel:SendAsync(msg) end
    else
        ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
    end
end)
